name: cinescope-mrs
description: CineScope Movie Recommendation System - Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend start"
